source.accounting: actual complete input plus output tokens from every source cell

deployment.correctness_and_performance: both neutral and promoted p000 satisfy frozen task gates after replication

proposed_prospective_policy.step_1: use trusted features or one bounded parser only when metadata is absent
proposed_prospective_policy.step_2: run neutral and lowest-cost qualified candidate p000 with two repetitions per task
proposed_prospective_policy.step_3: require correctness first, then candidate median performance within 1.25x of the fastest baseline, then at least 15% token saving
proposed_prospective_policy.step_4: when performance ordering is ambiguous or crosses the eligibility boundary across repetitions, add one paired neutral/candidate replication
proposed_prospective_policy.step_5: promote p000 and stop if all gates pass; test p100 only when p000 fails or a stricter performance objective requires another action
proposed_prospective_policy.zero_candidate_online_state: defer/unqualified; neutral may be a temporary safe fallback but not a cost verdict

result.next_action: freeze the staged neutral-p000-first policy before outcomes on a new family or repeated-task simulation

interpretation.why: finding a 52.6% cheaper Profile consumed far more tokens than one deployment saves; evidence acquisition is rational only when the task family will recur enough times
interpretation.minimum_design_change: Router policy must account for expected future reuse of the evidence itself, not only reuse inside the optimized program

claim_boundary: All staged-policy choices were evaluated after observing Reachability outcomes. The arithmetic uses actual source-cell tokens, but the reduced policy is a counterfactual replay and must be frozen prospectively before promotion claims.
